verdict.rationale: The docs describe a permissions system built on Deny/Ask/Allow access lists, with project-scoped permissions, permission adjustment via the CLI's /config, and MCP, plugin and hook configuration via slash commands. Community reports confirm an allowlist exists but show its default included webhook.site, which was used for exfiltration. A separate hands-on report says the agent bypassed its own .env access setting, which weakens confidence in how reliably these controls are enforced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the permission lists govern individual MCP servers and external tools, admin/team-level policy enforcement for an engineering lead, and independent confirmation that restrictions on external integrations hold in practice.
